Edit this ONE selected Work 1 figure. Produce ONE finished revised figure, not variants. Retain its overall 4:3 layout, serif academic typography, thin pale-blue grouping, mathematical formulas and three approved cost-curve shapes. This is a genuine image-model rendering, not SVG/code.

1. Every processing rectangle and every task-color legend swatch must be a UNIFORM SOLID COLOR across its entire interior. ALL occurrences of J3 have the SAME solid pink base. Hatching overlays keep the pink beneath them and do not replace it with white.

The top green [e3,d3] bar, BOTH shared completion rows, the convex curve's zero interval, and the step curve's zero interval must all lie between these EXACT SAME TWO VERTICAL ANCHORS. No independent panel rescaling. Treat this as one continuous pale-green timing column projected across the left sections, interrupted by opaque titles; fine faint vertical endpoint guides may connect plotting regions. Width of [e3,d3] is14.29% of the whole canvas everywhere.
3. Move J1's FIXED WINDOW later so its scheduled completion is INSIDE it. Use [e1,d1]=[3,6], J1 processing [0,4]. This is still a fixed-input scheduling illustration, not window assignment.
4. Correct EVERY job/window index. The purple J5 window must read EXACTLY “[e₅,d₅]”, not [e3,d5]. M2: J2[0,3], idle gap[3,6], J4[6,12], J6[12,17].
J4 and J6 physically touch. Label the large gaps “Idle time”; do not cram text into the small gap.
Windows: J1[3,6], J2[1,4], J3[10,18], J4[10,14], J5[21,25], J6[15,20]. Each has its correct ej,dj label above its own machine row. All six MAIN completion points are inside their given due windows; we do not claim this is an optimal schedule. Do not print the example's numerical times; they are drawing instructions. Only Jj,pj,Cj and [ej,dj] appear.
5. Identical physical processing length p3 EVERYWHERE, including the small top-right parameter legend. p3=4 corresponds to7.14% of the WHOLE canvas width. Do not stretch the legend's pink J3 bar into a long decoration. Main J3, both completion examples, both work examples and legend J3 must all have this SAME physical width. The green window width is exactly TWICE a J3 processing block.
6. On the RIGHT work examples, show early/tardy WORK on the actual pink J3 block, with overlaid thin blue/red diagonal hatching, not independent blocks outside it. Same right time scale as the left, translated: t6 x65%,t24 x97.14%, e3 x72.14%, d3 x86.43%. Both right [e3,d3] windows and right work-cost graph's corresponding e3/d3 must align.

Tardy-work row: processing[16,20], so d3=18 bisects its pink block. Hatch ONLY the right half [18,20] in red; base stays pink. Dimension arrow TW3 sits ABOVE the hatched half.
Use S3,C3 without superscripts. All work blocks have p3 width7.14% and windows width14.29%.
The LEFT completion examples are DIFFERENT: early job[4,8] plus separate blue E3 gap[8,10] BELOW the block; late job[16,20] plus separate red T3 gap[18,20] BELOW the block. Keep these charged time gaps outside the pink processing rectangles. This distinguishes time deviations from work volumes.
7. The three function graphs are approved. Keep exact straight segments and their shapes. Improve Chinese lettering with correct real glyphs, not pseudo-Chinese. Full cost titles:
“Weighted earliness and tardiness cost”
